name: Interpolation Degree
definition: The interpolation degree of a finite nonempty class $\mathcal H\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$ is the least $d$ such that every function on $\mathcal H$ is represented by a polynomial of total degree at most $d$ modulo the affine vanishing ideal $I^0_{\mathcal H}$.
parameters: A coefficient field may be specified.
normalization: A singleton has interpolation degree zero.
